Deliverable mistaken for a downstream need: the winner was awarded a substrate supply contract, so pitching it materials is contradicted.
Irish SaaS HRIS award is off-territory and a global software vendor subcontracting construction lots is commercially absurd.
1.37M CHF fresh in-territory sanitary works matching an ICP primary, but the trade hook stays thin for a generalist supplier.

CH engineering mandate above threshold and in territory, but a large multidisciplinary planner like Emch+Berger typically covers SIA phases 41-53 in-house, so the subcontracting need is only generically supported.
Italian security-guard consortium: the workforce category matches nominally, but a supplier of construction site inputs has no coherent reason to call four vigilanza firms.
Swiss civil works in territory and above threshold, but it is a 707k supplementary order to a very large contractor and only the secondary PPE category is added to a generic workforce need.
GE HealthCare servicing its own ultrasound fleet in Finland: outside the ICP territories and no plausible construction-input need at a device OEM.
4.1M CHF Swiss pipeline job with a concrete 3.9 km scope hitting both ICP primaries plus equipment — a construction-inputs supplier would clearly want this.
Norwegian electrician framework with no published value: outside territory, threshold unverifiable, and no construction-input need.
Supercomputer maintenance awarded to HP Switzerland — right country, but no coherent construction-inputs opportunity at a global IT OEM.
Cypriot coach operator moving national guard troops: outside the ICP territories and unrelated to construction inputs.
Swiss plastering/drywall package of the right size and type for a PPE supplier, but the signal only carries a generic workforce need and never derives the PPE need this ICP actually sells.
Czech architectural design mandate: place of performance CZ falls outside an ICP whose name and territory list are explicitly Western Europe.
Multi-year Swiss geomatics mandate with field monitoring could interest a BTP staffing agency, but the derived need is the secondary subcontracting category with unknown timing.
Underwater lake cleaning in Greece by a sole operator: outside territory and no construction-inputs fit.
16.6M CHF Generalplaner mandate for ASTRA is the textbook specialist-subcontracting lead — right country, well above threshold, recent, and the need follows directly from the contract form.
4.9M EUR French job laying 7.6 km of DN600 pipe with execution already started: concrete, in territory, and hits both ICP primaries plus equipment.
Large Swiss engineering mandate in exact territory, but AP/DP design phases generate office rather than site labour, so the fit for a BTP staffing agency is uncertain.
Green-space maintenance in Treviso: place of performance IT is outside the ICP's territories and grounds upkeep is not a specialist technical construction lot.
Swiss HVAC installation package of the right type and size, but Equans is a large group with central procurement and the PPE need itself was never derived.
11.4M EUR turnkey school extension won by a developer/service company in Germany — a Totalübernehmer subcontracts nearly every trade, which is exactly this ICP's business.
Swiss cable-duct lot near 1M CHF touches both ICP primaries, but it is a supplementary order on work already under way, weakening the why-now.
Danish guard services with no published value: outside territory and unrelated to construction inputs.
1.5M CHF Swiss metalwork package in territory with a plausible workforce need, but the obvious materials angle was never derived and the fabricator sources its own components.
3-year Orsted billing platform implementation with an immediate start, matching a remote specialist ICP that has no geographic or value constraint — a clear subcontracting lead.
3M CHF Swiss timber/facade package is a natural PPE prospect, but the signal presents only a generic workforce need rather than the safety need this ICP sells.
Swedish groundworks framework: outside the ICP territories, no published value, and the framework started nearly a year before publication.

Swedish waste-vacuum O&M service contract: outside the ICP's required territories, wrong contract type (services, not construction), and no derived need at all.
Annual software adaptation of a cantonal tax application creates no plausible demand for construction inputs, workforce or PPE.
Lab mass-spectrometer supply by Thermo Fisher: the equipment is the deliverable, not a downstream need, and the ICP covers construction materials only.
Factory-produced rail switch components delivered to build a spare-parts stock; no site execution and no plausible demand for chantier inputs at a steel manufacturer.
Czech road-signage lot at roughly EUR 13k: outside the ICP's required territories and an order of magnitude below its EUR 200k floor.
Pure SIA planning mandate won by an engineering consultancy — a planner specifies materials but never buys chantier inputs.
Swedish housing contractor against a Switzerland-only PPE supplier, with an unpublished value and a boilerplate 'see procurement documents' description; the workforce need is generic.
Commercially attractive CHF 6.25M facade package, but the ICP declares euro-zone territories with geography required and no need was derived — the territorial exclusion is the customer's own rule.
Empty record: no title, no CPV, no value, no dates and no derived need — nothing a salesperson could act on.

Largest and best-aligned pairing in the batch — CHF 11.76M multi-year HPC maintenance against a geography-free specialist-subcontracting ICP — but no need was articulated and HP is a tier-1 integrator with deep in-house capacity.
Supported self-rehabilitation animation mission: a social-support mandate, not construction, with unpublished value and an award roughly six months past the ICP's 120-day window.
Police application security upgrade and software maintenance — no connection to construction inputs, workforce or PPE.
Scientific dilution refrigerator delivered in Austria: outside the ICP's required territories, wrong contract type, and the instrument is the deliverable.

Roughly CHF 941k general-planner mandate covering ventilation upgrade and a central cooling plant under a broad CH-inclusive ICP with the value threshold met — defensible either way, though the winner is a planner and not a buyer of chantier inputs.
Finnish cleaning-services mini-competition at EUR 60k judged against a Swiss construction-site safety supplier: wrong country, wrong contract type, below threshold.
Research collaboration awarded to a university institute; academic data analysis is performed in-house and is a poor prospect for commercial specialist subcontracting.
Swedish municipal waste-treatment qualification with a content-free description, evaluated against a Switzerland-only PPE ICP restricted to construction.
CHF 30.5k scaffolding lot, far below the ICP's CHF 100k floor, and scaffolding is the winner's deliverable rather than a downstream need.
Neurosurgical instrument set in Poland: outside the ICP's required territories, medical supply rather than construction, and below the EUR 200k floor.
Swiss traffic-management control-system replacement — outside the ICP's required territories, and the work is system migration with little construction-materials content.
Polish medical supply lot at roughly EUR 47k: territorial mismatch, wrong contract type, and below the value floor.
Software licence maintenance and support; nothing in the contract creates demand for construction inputs.
Romanian building-services maintenance at roughly EUR 63k against a Switzerland-only construction PPE ICP: wrong country, wrong contract type, below threshold.
Building-cleaning package in CH against a euro-zone materials ICP with geography required; the derived equipment need also mis-describes the work as earthworks/civil engineering.

Swiss cooling-plant works against a eurozone materials trader whose territory list is required and excludes CH: hard geographic mismatch.
Interior blind installation worth 51k EUR, far below the ICP's CHF 100k floor and in Berlin rather than Switzerland, with only a generic workforce need.
A cloud backup software subscription resale creates no demand for construction site inputs; no need was derived and none is plausible.
Pure equipment supply of electrical transducers to rail warehouses, outside the ICP's construction-only scope and with no building-materials need at the winner.
Canon leasing a print press to a cantonal tax office has no connection to construction workforce or materials.
Liquid nitrogen supply to CNRS laboratories is Air Liquide's own deliverable, not a downstream construction-materials need.
The extra resources described are past telecom-engineering effort already compensated by this supplement, not a forward need for site inputs.
Waste-centre operation in the Yvelines is facility services outside the ICP's construction-only scope and out of reach of a Switzerland-only PPE supplier.

The remote-specialist ICP has no geographic or type filter and a CHF 774k munitions-clearance programme is technically demanding enough to interest a specialist subcontractor, but the signal carries no derived need at all.
Foaming chemicals for Romanian gas wells, signed in 2024, outside both the required territory and any construction-materials relevance.
A general-planner fee supplement makes AFRY a buyer of engineering hours, not of the site inputs this ICP sells.
Spices and salts for a Liege hospital at 24k EUR has no coherent link to a construction materials trader.
Credible materials need on a CHF 520k metal-door package, but the ICP requires performance in the eurozone list and this is in Switzerland.
Rail securing services with a published value of 0 EUR, outside the construction scope and below any usable threshold for a materials trader.
ICT governance consulting for the canton of Zurich generates no demand for construction capacity or materials.
Czech pharmaceutical wholesale of a cytostatic drug: wrong country, wrong sector, no plausible need.
A university institute doing track measurement research is not a buyer of construction workforce or materials.
Right country and right contract type, but a 15k EUR joinery job of trim strips and a kitchenette is an order of magnitude below the ICP's 200k floor.
Screed flooring work carries a real materials need, but the performance site is Swiss and this ICP's territory filter is required, not preferred.
Empty record with no title, description, CPV, value or contract type: nothing a salesperson could act on.
Swiss lift installation against a eurozone-required ICP, and Schindler installs its own manufactured product rather than buying materials.
In-territory and above threshold, but the winner is a planning office delivering HOAI design phases; the civil-works materials go to a different contractor.
Strongest materials need in the batch on a CHF 1.2M concrete reservoir build, but Gadmen is in Switzerland and this ICP hard-requires a eurozone place of performance.
